opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.change: Coalesce task waits and status notifications before another model turn.
opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.evidence: 18 timed-out wait-only turns cost $0.2666752 while tasks remained running; all 24 wait-only turns cost $0.3638841.
opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.limit: These historical activity totals are not measured savings or wholly removable spend; keep completion, failure and user-progress delivery.

opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.change: Bound browser/tool evidence and summarize completed work while preserving stable cacheable prefixes.
opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.evidence: All 300 requests processed 25,861,524 input tokens; cached reads cost $2.4992788 and cache writes cost $2.14254. Wait-only prompt input grew from 26,476 to 126,060 tokens.
opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.limit: Processed input includes replay. Shorter context can lose evidence or invalidate caches; quality and total delivery cost require a new controlled run.

opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.change: Reuse digest-bound deterministic verification receipts and batch checks, with targeted independent judge validation.
opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.evidence: QA and judge account for 101 requests and $2.8677502; their work includes useful API, browser, concurrency and permission verification.
opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.limit: Do not remove required QA or independent judging or assume their full cost is redundant. Evidence reuse must bind the delivered source and relevant test state.

opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.change: Reserve request capacity for final checks and repair earlier in implementation.

opportunitiesForFutureControlledStage.limit: No successful repair or lower-cost counterfactual is established. Any future phase allocation needs its own reviewed freeze.
